timeline.labelEn: A planning memo sketches an oval flyover for Düsseldorf's Mörsenbroicher Ei junction, the origin of its “egg” name
timeline.labelDe: Eine Denkschrift skizziert eine ovale Hochbrücke für die Düsseldorfer Kreuzung Mörsenbroicher Ei – Ursprung des Namens „Ei“

questions.notes: Multiple choice reworked. One of Germany's largest at-grade road junctions, in Düsseldorf; the oval flyover planned after 1955 was never built.

timeline.labelDe: Der Psychiater William F. Fry beginnt in Stanford die Erforschung der Körperwirkungen des Lachens – Beginn der Gelotologie

questions.notes: True/false reworked: the card's claim (laughter raises blood pressure — briefly during a hearty laugh, followed by a drop) could not be pinned to a fetched source with one clear answer, so the question asks for the science of laughter's effects instead.
